info.title: dbapi-sepaCreditTransfer
info.description: Easily initiate SEPA Credit Transfers, both single and bulk, with complementary operations such as status checks, details retrieval, cancellation, second factor retry and payee verification.

tags.name: Create SEPA Credit Transfers
tags.description: Use these endpoints to create SEPA Credit Transfers. Both single and bulk payments are supported.

tags.name: Get status for SEPA Credit Transfers
tags.description: Use these endpoints to retrieve the processing status of SEPA Credit Transfers, both for single and bulk payments.

tags.name: Get details for SEPA Credit Transfers
tags.description: Use these endpoints to retrieve the details of SEPA Credit Transfers, both for single and bulk payments.

tags.name: Cancel SEPA Credit Transfers
tags.description: Use these endpoints to cancel existing SEPA Credit Transfers.

tags.name: Second Factor Retry
tags.description: Use these endpoints for Second Factory Retry of existing SEPA Credit Transfers.

tags.name: Get VoP details for SEPA Credit Transfers
tags.description: Use these endpoints to check the Verification of Payee (VoP) details for your SEPA Credit Transfers, whether you're making a single payment or a bulk transfer.

post.description: Initiate a SEPA Credit Transfer from your own or your customer’s account to another SEPA account. The transaction(s) must be approved within five minutes. Strong Customer Authentication (SCA) is required prior to the final execution of the payment. Should the second factor authentication fail, it may be retried for the same paymentId using the Second Factor Retry endpoint, without the need to re-initiate the payment, provided the five-minute time window has not elapsed.

parameters.name: idempotency-id
parameters.description: Unique id of the service call. Must be present during retries to avoid multiple processing of the same request

parameters.name: Correlation-Id
parameters.description: Free form key controlled by the caller e.g. uuid

It can be called if the payment initiation did not return a final VoP response and the status is TRY_AGAIN.

numberOfTransactions.description: Total number of transactions in the bulk file for the provided payment id.

VopResponseStatusCode.description: Status indicating the availability of the result. Possible values: READY - The VoP result is available and returned in the response. TRY_AGAIN - The VoP result is not ready yet. Please try again. NOT_AVAILABLE - VoP service is not available.

numberOfTransactions.description: Number of transactions with VoP status value MATCH, NO_MATCH, CLOSE_MATCH and NOT_APPLICABLE

VopStatus.description: The outcome of the Verification of Payee check, which compares the beneficiary's name provided in the payment with the name registered at the beneficiary's bank. Possible values are: MATCH - The beneficiary's name fully matches. NO_MATCH - The beneficiary's name does not match. CLOSE_MATCH - The beneficiary's name is very similar to the one registered at the beneficiary's bank. NOT_APPLICABLE - The VoP check could not be carried out (e.g. the beneficiary's bank does not support the service)

CloseMatchName.description: The creditor account holder's name as officially registered by the beneficiary's bank, provided when the vopStatus is CLOSE_MATCH.

PaymentInformationBase.description: Details related to the debtor, including account information, requested execution date and other settings defined for the request.

ChargeBearer.description: Indicates who bears the transaction charges. Under the SEPA scheme, the only permitted value is SLEV.

CreditTransferTransactionInformation.description: Information about the payment, focusing on the creditor (beneficiary side) such as amount, currency, account and remittance information.

GroupHeaderBase.description: General message information about the payment request.

BatchBooking.description: Validated as true or false. If present and contains "true", batch booking is requested. If present and contains "false", booking per transaction is requester. If element is not present, pre-agreed customer-to-PSP conditions apply.

PaymentInformationId.description: Unique identification, as assigned by a sending party, to unambiguously identify the payment information.

PaymentMethod.description: Specifies the means of payment that will be used to move the amount of money. Only TRF allowed for now.

NumberOfTransactions.description: The total number of Payment Instructions within this request.

ControlSum.description: The total sum of all Instructed Amounts within this request.

RequestedExecutionDate.description: Must match yyyy-MM-dd format, also in CET timezone.

CreateDateTime.description: Must match yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss' format. Timestamp of request creation date and time at which the message was created.

DebtorAgent.description: Financial institution servicing an account for the debtor. This field is optional but if provided, it must contain a valid financialInstitutionId.

CreditorAgent.description: Financial institution servicing an account for the creditor. This field is optional but if provided, it must contain a valid financialInstitutionId.

RemittanceInformationUnstructured.description: Free text reference related to the business transaction (e.g. invoice number, contract reference, order Id).

street.description: Street name is Optional. If provided, streetAndHouseNumber must be ignored

houseNumber.description: House number is Optional. If provided, streetAndHouseNumber must be ignored

city.description: Town/city name.Optional. If provided, zipCodeAndCity must be ignored

zipCode.description: Postal Code. Optional. If provided, zipCodeAndCity must be ignored

AddressLine.description: This Object is deprecated and will be completely removed after November 2026. Please use other address fields to submit addresses.

EndToEndIdentification.description: Unique identification assigned by the initiating party to unambiguously identify the transaction.

FinancialInstitutionId.description: BICFI - Business identifier code for financial institutions. Standard SWIFT code used to uniquely identify banks and other financial institutions. Must be 8 or 11 alphanumeric characters.

CreditorName.description: Name by which a party is known and which is usually used to identify that party.

message.description: Description of the belonging error code.

messageId.description: dbAPI internal message-id (unique identifier) that allow reference to each of your API calls.

TransactionStatus.description: Transaction Status: Specifies the status of a transaction in a coded form. RCVD - Received. The payment instruction has been successfully received. This is only a technical receipt. Further validation is still required. ACTC - AcceptedTechnicalValidation. The payment instruction has passed all necessary technical validations. ACSP - AcceptedSettlementInProcess. The payment has been accepted for execution and settlement is in progress. RJCT - Rejected. The payment instruction has been rejected following negative validation results. CANC – Cancelled. The payment initiation has been cancelled before execution.

Action.description: Defines the action for retry second factor, CREATE is for updating the second factor for create SEPA Credit Transfer and CANCEL is for cancel.

PaymentId.description: Resource identification of the generated paymentinitiation resource ('Transaction-ID' from the header which is populated with the Intra Bank ID); should be available at least when status is PDNG or ACCP.

AuthId.description: Authentication Id used for update SCA status SEPA payment; it will be valid for 5 minutes.

CreationDateTime.description: Creation time of SEPA Bulk Credit Transfers.

SupplementaryDataForWhole.description: Supplementary Details of Bulk SEPA Credit Transfers
